slides.title: A short change can fall between samples
slides.premise: Fewer stored readings reduce the size of a log.
slides.question:
Which brief changes remain
when we keep fewer readings?
sources: [1] Synthetic classroom trace, supplied teaching input (2026).
slides.notes: This question does not assert an effect on health or battery life.

slides.interpretation: The retained representation never reaches the synthetic peak of 1140 ppm.
sources: [1] Synthetic values in input.json; retained values use the last recorded sample.
slides.notes: The retained representation repeats the last retained reading for display; these repeats are not additional measurements. The synthetic peak is not a safety threshold. No real-world detection claim.

slides.title: A recording rule determines what can be seen
takeaways: Question: which short changes survive sparse recording?
Synthetic example: one peak is absent from the retained representation.
Next: compare rules across traces before building a prototype.
